title: Our School
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Accidents are taught with the safe action first; a child who is hurt tells a teacher at once (SAFE).

skills.key_step: The child names ways of keeping the school clean and knows it is everyone's duty.

floor.question: What do we use to sweep the floor?

representations: brooms, dusters and a litter bin
pictures of a clean and a dirty compound
steps: Name places at school that need cleaning.

board.do: Draw a classroom with litter on the floor.
Wait for the child to say pick it and put it in the bin.
Write: bin, sweep, dust, wash hands.

misconceptions.ask: Who should keep our classroom clean?
misconceptions.repair: Make a class duty rota. Everyone keeps the class clean.

listen_for: On the ground, it is small
misconceptions.ask: Where should a sweet paper go?
misconceptions.repair: Drop one paper each for the class: count how many. Small litter adds up.

misconceptions.ask: Before sweeping a dusty floor, what should you do?
misconceptions.repair: Sweep a dusty corner dry and wet. See the dust cloud. Dust makes us cough.

misconceptions.ask: When must you wash your hands at school?
misconceptions.repair: Use glitter as "germs" on hands and see how they spread. Wash with soap.

skills.key_step: The child names common accidents at school, says how each can be prevented and what to do when hurt.

floor.question: Name one accident that can happen at home.

representations: a walk around school to find danger spots
steps: Name the accident that could happen.
Say what to do if hurt.
contexts: a wet corridor on a rainy day

board.do: Draw a corridor with a wet floor and a running child.
Wait for the child to say he could slip and fall.
Write: walk, keep floors dry, tell a teacher.

misconceptions.ask: Can we prevent falls in the classroom?
misconceptions.repair: For each accident card, ask: what could we do first so it does not happen?

listen_for: Hide it so I am not punished
misconceptions.ask: You cut your hand on a broken window. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Say clearly: when you are hurt, always tell a teacher. You will be helped.

listen_for: Pick it up with my hands
misconceptions.ask: You see broken glass on the path. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play: stand near, warn friends, call a teacher. Adults pick up glass.

misconceptions.ask: Is it safe to run in the corridor?
misconceptions.repair: Show how a corner hides someone coming. Practise walking in corridors.

checks.question: Name a common accident at school.
What do you do if you get hurt?
